doc.brief: The QMenuBar class provides a horizontal menu bar.

NSMenu * toNSMenu().brief: Returns the native NSMenu for this menu bar.

QAction * activeAction() const.brief: Returns the [QAction](xref:qt:QAction) that is currently highlighted, if any, else `nullptr`.

QAction * addSeparator().brief: Appends a separator to the menu.

QAction * insertMenu(QAction *before, QM.brief: This convenience function inserts *menu* before action *before* and returns the menus menuAction().

QAction * insertSeparator(QAction *befor.brief: This convenience function creates a new separator action, i.e. an action with [QAction::isSeparator](xref:qt:QAction)() returning true.

QMenu * addMenu(const QIcon &icon, const.brief: Appends a new [QMenu](xref:qt:QMenu) with *icon* and *title* to the menu bar.

QMenu * addMenu(const QString &title).brief: Appends a new [QMenu](xref:qt:QMenu) with *title* to the menu bar.

QMenuBar(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a menu bar with parent *parent*.

QRect actionGeometry(QAction *act) const.brief: Returns the geometry of action *act* as a [QRect](xref:qt:QRect).

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QSize sizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::sizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QWidget * cornerWidget(Qt::Corner corner.brief: Returns the widget on the left of the first or on the right of the last menu item, depending on *corner*.

bool isDefaultUp() const.brief: This property holds the popup orientation

bool isNativeMenuBar() const.brief: This property holds whether or not a menubar will be used as a native menubar on platforms that support it

void clear().brief: Removes all the actions from the menu bar.

void hovered(QAction *action).brief: This signal is emitted when a menu action is highlighted; *action* is the action that caused the event to be sent.

void initStyleOption(QStyleOptionMenuIte.brief: Initialize *option* with the values from the menu bar and information from *action*.

void setActiveAction(QAction *act).brief: Sets the currently highlighted action to *act*.

void setCornerWidget(QWidget *widget, Qt.brief: This sets the given *widget* to be shown directly on the left of the first menu item, or on the right of the last menu item, depending on *corner*.

void setDefaultUp(bool).brief: This property holds the popup orientation

void setNativeMenuBar(bool nativeMenuBar.brief: This property holds whether or not a menubar will be used as a native menubar on platforms that support it

void setVisible(bool visible) override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::visible](xref:qt:QWidget).

void triggered(QAction *action).brief: This signal is emitted when an action in a menu belonging to this menubar is triggered as a result of a mouse click; *action* is the action that caused the signal to be emitted.

nativeMenuBar.brief: Whether or not a menubar will be used as a native menubar on platforms that support it
